scope: Private authenticated Cloudflare Worker path. Fixed requested windows, unchanged per-wallet capacity, one active signer and one active preparer. Historical baseline; no causal attribution of the unexplained producer speed change.

comparison.scope: Same pool limits and workloads. Historical baseline; no randomized contemporaneous control. Finite observations do not establish production percentiles or maximum capacity.

after_starting_stock.scope: Each excluded pair has either a terminal client response backed by identical A/B taken events, or one recorded deadline with no taken event. The interval starts after the latest bound. A material deadline proves no later contribution; its retirement cause stays unobserved. This finite interval does not prove full reserve restoration or maximum sustainable capacity.

admission_preflight.scope: Router invocation logs distinguish empty inventory hints from subsequent exclusive claims. These counts do not measure slot occupancy time.

observed_reserve_cycle.scope: Finite load plus the earliest captured set of full reserve observations, each no older than 45 seconds. Observation delay is included. This is not a maximum-capacity claim.
